Class GuiController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.client.view.gui.guiScreens.GuiController
public abstract class GuiController extends Object
Abstract base class that defines the interface for handling user interactions in the GUI. This controller acts as an intermediary between GUI elements and game logic, providing methods for various user actions during different phases of the game. Concrete implementations will handle phase-specific behaviors.

      public void handlePointPress(Point currentPoint)

      currentPoint - The coordinates where the user clicked

    • goNext

      public void goNext()
      Advances to the next step or phase in the current game flow. This method is typically triggered by "next" or "continue" buttons.

      Parameters:

      public void requestRandComponent()
      Requests a random component from the available component pool. Typically used during the ship building phase.

      public void rejectComponent()
      Rejects the currently selected component, returning it to the rejected pile. Used when a player decides not to use a component during ship building.

      public void requestComponent(int id)

    • grabStashedComponent

      public void grabStashedComponent(int i)
      Retrieves a component from the player's stash at the specified index. Used when a player wants to use a previously stashed component.
      Parameters:
      i - The index of the component in the player's stash

    • stashComponent

      public void stashComponent()
      Stashes the currently held component for later use. Allows players to save components during ship building.

    • rotateHandComponent

      public void rotateHandComponent()
      Rotates the component currently in the player's hand. Used during ship building to orient components before placement.

      public void acquireForecast(int finalI)
